prototypeScope: V1.9 Orange increment on top of the printed V1.8 set: the rear electronics pack with the BNO085 rib and the shell seat bars, the head cap for the neck-route and audio extension (speaker collar, amplifier posts, no rear notch), the speaker retainer, and the four neck-bundle cable clips (torso, bracket, head, cap). Every other printed part stays, including the V1.8 Black rear pack cover.
knownFitBoundary: BNO085: two M2 x 4 through the board into the pack rib at the bench, before pack-in. Shells: the printed V1.8 shells rest on the pack bars (0.15/0.27 mm roof gap). Cap: same three closure screws as V1.8; E-pi-04 becomes M2 x 8 under the cap clip; speaker retainer 2 x M2 x 6, amplifier 2 x M2 x 6. Clips: 2 mm tabs under S12-horn-025 (M2 x 8), S11-horn-040 (M2 x 8), H-jaw_support-03 (M2.5 x 8) and E-pi-04. Physical checks remain: clip shapes are untested in print, and the jaw pose-cap table does not yet model the clips and wires (ext-v19/README.md).
processOverrideReason: Head cap tip angle 7.7 degrees (ext-v19/checks/orientation-ext-v19.json) is below the 10 degree line in guide/print/orientation-study/PRINT-ORIENTATION-PRACTICE.md; 4 mm outer brim carried over from V1.8.

parts.changeReason: V1.9 rear electronics pack: a BNO085 rib on the plate front face with two M2 x 4 pilots replaces the shelf and its zip-tie slots (the board is screwed on at the bench before pack-in); the T-head is grown 0.4 mm all round and two 3 mm shoulder bars behind the plate seat the printed V1.8 side shells (roof gap 0.15 mm left, 0.27 mm right instead of 0.55/0.71). The DFR1202 front lips and corner feet are removed, so the OpenRB-150 slides straight in and out from behind with both side shells on and only the cover off (0 collisions, 0.6 mm side clearance; rear-pack-v19/check_v19_board_rear.json). Notch, cable lanes, cover posts, the empty DFR channel, OpenRB pads and the four hip-yaw screw tabs are unchanged from V1.8; the V1.8 cover stays.
